stockSync.title: Order stock sync
stockSync.description: WooCommerce orders reduce Inventory stock by exact SKU. Refunds, cancellations, and failed orders restore the previously booked quantity.

stockSync.statusRule: Stock is issued for on-hold, processing, and completed orders. Refunds, cancelled, failed, pending, and refunded states are reconciled with compensating returns.

guide.title: Create the API credentials in WooCommerce

guide.step2: Choose a dedicated WordPress user and grant Read/Write access so Inventory can register the order webhooks.
guide.step3: Copy the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret before leaving WooCommerce, then enter both above.

explanation.title: Why field-aware and item-contextual?
explanation.body: A changed description does not spend tokens retranslating an unchanged title. The AI still receives the complete item and translates every stale field in one request, so terminology stays coherent across the record.
